summary: Complete independent initial canonical date audit of the exact pinned source and extraction. All 88 Chinese source units, 82 temporal and active-date-hint items, and 27 people were reviewed. Six repairable chronology/hint errors were found: Emperor Yin’s accession is a specific AD 948 event rather than an AD 948–950 interval; the related active-date hints require the same exactness; 郭忠恕’s 乾祐中 appointment is only an era-wide AD 948–950 attestation, not AD 949; and an invented 乾祐至廣順 range combines a dated AD 950 political episode with an undated later-life notice. No life date is inferred from the later reception or undated exile notice.
